SELECT user_info.id AS user_id, user_info.org_id AS user_org_id, role_info.id AS role_id, role_info.data_scope_type, role_data_org.org_id AS custom_org_id
FROM sys_user user_info
LEFT JOIN sys_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = user_info.id
LEFT JOIN sys_role role_info ON role_info.id = user_role.role_id AND role_info.status = TRUE
LEFT JOIN sys_role_data_org role_data_org ON role_data_org.role_id = role_info.id AND role_info.data_scope_type = 'CUSTOM_ORG'
WHERE user_info.id = #{userId} AND user_info.enabled = TRUE
ORDER BY role_info.id, role_data_org.org_id

WITH RECURSIVE organize_tree (id) AS ( SELECT organize_info.id FROM sys_organize organize_info WHERE organize_info.id = #{orgId}
UNION
SELECT child_info.id FROM sys_organize child_info JOIN organize_tree parent_info ON child_info.parent_id = parent_info.id )
SELECT id FROM organize_tree ORDER BY id
